_comment: DATA-384: which source record_intention gets, by whose words the text is. The contract for the skill's examples (skills/record-intention/SKILL.md, "## Source") and the rule in _record_intention.py SOURCE_RULE / DRAFT_RULE. said: what the resident said or wrote (or, for background, what a memory pass read). where: conversation | onboarding | note | background. text: what the agent records. source: the source the rule gives. draft_first: the agent shows text in chat before it calls the tool. Checked by plugins/av-events/tests/test_intention_source.py; no model runs.
